reportCta.text: Want a complete report of our activities from 2021 to 2026?

events.title: City Palace Dhundhadi Play
events.description: Conducted a 30-day Theatre Workshop in Sanskritik Virasat Prashikshan Shivir. Directed stage play 'Sanatan Ra Prahari Maharaja Mansingh Ji Pahla' in Dhundhadi language, performed at Sarvato Bhadra, City Palace.

events.title: 8th Rajrangam Festival
events.meta: 04 April – 31 May 2026 • Jawahar Kala Kendra, Jaipur
events.description: Organized the national-level 8th Rajasthan Rang Mahotsav, showcasing 3 full-length stage plays (Flirt, Tartuffe, Gopichand Bhartrihari), 2 street plays (Nukkad Natak), a seminar, and a directors' art exhibition.

events.title: ISKCON Cultural Camp Play
events.meta: 18 May – 01 June 2026 • Shri Shri Krishna Balram Mandir, Jaipur
events.description: Directed a 15-day theatre workshop at ISKCON Temple, Jagatpura, culminating in the play 'Gupt Vrindavan Ka Rahasya' staged at Rasikam Auditorium.

events.title: Ma Bharati ki Pukar
events.description: Staged the play 'Ma Bharati ki Pukar' for the State Level Prakritik Kheti Karyashala, organized by Kisan Morcha of BJP Rajasthan.

events.title: Murlipura School Workshop
events.meta: 19 March 2026 • Govt. Girls Sr. Sec. School, Murlipura
events.description: Conducted a children's theatre workshop designed to build confidence, vocal expression, and artistic awareness.

events.title: Ruparampura School Workshop
events.description: Organized and directed an acting and storytelling workshop for rural children to build connection and creative expression.

events.title: Kalpurush (Krantikari Veer Savarkar)
events.description: Performed the historical play 'Kalpurush-Krantikari Veer Savarkar' at the Mini Theatre, Ravindra Manch, directed by Dr. Chandradeep Hada.

events.title: 2nd Lok Natya Prayogotsav
events.description: Staged 'Raja Bharthari' and 'Raja Mordhvaj' based on Turrakalangi and Kuchamani Khyal styles. Sanctioned by Sangeet Natak Akademi, New Delhi.

events.title: Akhand Bharat Street Campaign
events.description: Staged 4 shows of street play 'Akhand Bharat-Sapna Nahin Sankalp' across Jaipur to promote national integration, in association with Rudra Foundation.

events.title: SNA Youth Hostel Workshop
events.description: Conducted a 30-day professional theatre workshop sponsored and approved by Sangeet Natak Akademi, New Delhi.

events.title: Acharya Bhikshu Stage Play
events.description: Directed stage play 'Acharya Bhikshu (Janma se Diksha)' for Terapanth Mahila Mandal, depicting the spiritual journey of the Acharya.

events.title: NSD Vishva Jan Rang Mahotsav
events.description: Staged 'Pancham Ved' for the prestigious Vishva Jan Rang Mahotsav organized by the National School of Drama, New Delhi.

events.title: 7th Rajrangam Festival
events.description: Staged 5 stage plays, 1 seminar, and a 5-day exhibition. sanctioned by the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India.

events.title: Agnipath at Rang Swadhinta
events.description: Staged play 'Agnipath' on the occasion of the 78th Independence Day in SNA's Rang Swadhinta Jashna. Written by Lt. Mahendra Jain.

events.title: Bangkok International Workshop & Play
events.description: Traveled internationally to conduct a 3-day workshop with the Thai-Indian Theatre Club and staged 'Ram Lala Ghar Aaye' at the Marriott, Bangkok.

events.title: Baral Kranti Play
events.description: Staged the historical narrative 'Baral Kranti' for the release of Dr. Nimisha Gaur's book at the Rajasthan International Centre (RIC).

events.title: 1st Lok Natya Prayogotsav
events.description: Staged traditional folk plays 'Shiv Mahima' and 'Bheli Bat' on an open stage. Sanctioned by Sangeet Natak Akademi, New Delhi.

events.title: 25th Bharat Rang Mahotsav (NSD)
events.description: Performed street play 'Lo Aai Vapas Sone ki Chidiya' as Director and Lead Actor for the silver jubilee celebration of NSD's Bharat Rang Mahotsav.

events.title: Vanikaran Environmental Campaign
events.description: Performed 50 street play shows in schools, colleges, and public spots on forest conservation, in partnership with Vandematram Sanstha.

events.title: Kar Himmat Campaign
events.description: Co-ordinated and performed 540 street play shows across 9 districts to promote youth empowerment and health, in partnership with Rajasthan Patrika.

events.title: Election Voter Awareness Campaign
events.description: Staged voter awareness street plays, puppets, and magic shows. ATR teams staged 60 shows in Sanganer, Adarsh Nagar, and Hawa Mahal areas.

events.title: Meri Maa Stage Production
events.description: Staged 'Meri Maa' in the 1st Lok Natya Prayogotsav. Staged before SNA Chairman Dr. Sandhya Purecha, adapted by Jairoop Jeevan.

events.title: ISKCON Children camps
events.description: Directed two intensive 21-day children's acting camps at ISKCON Temple, Jagatpura, culminating in stages of the play 'Prakatya'.

events.title: Veer Savarkar 90-Day Camp
events.description: Conducted a 90-day play workshop sanctioned by Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India, culminating in play 'Kalpurush' at Birla Auditorium.
